description: This source file defines a static internal class 'Adam7' which handles calculations for the Adam7 interlacing method used in PNG images. It provides methods to determine the number of scanlines per pass, pixels per scanline, and pixel coordinates within a pass, based on image header dimensions and pass index.

classes.name: Adam7
classes.description: A static class providing methods for PNG Adam7 interlacing calculations, including mapping passes to grid indices and pixel positions.

methods.name: GetNumberOfScanlinesInPass
methods.description: Calculates the number of scanlines for a given pass based on the image height.

methods.name: GetPixelsPerScanlineInPass
methods.description: Calculates the number of pixels per scanline within a specified pass based on the image width.

methods.name: GetPixelIndexForScanlineInPass
methods.description: Returns the (x, y) coordinate of a specific pixel within a given scanline and pass.
